raster_policy.rule: Every generation starts at raster 1. Any technical failure in rasters 2-6 is handed to raster 1. Raster 1 diagnoses and applies only safe whitelisted infrastructure repairs, then the same generation restarts from raster 1 and proceeds again through raster 2 onward.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Central health, diagnosis and recovery owner. Verify executables, dependencies, public data, configs, checkpoints and safety boundaries; diagnose failures from every later raster; apply only safe infrastructure repairs; then restart the same generation from raster 1.
Generate and optimize challenger hypotheses using training data only. Any technical blocker is returned to raster 1.
Backtest and score repeatable target hits, returns and trade evidence. Any technical blocker is returned to raster 1.
Reject incomplete, failed, cherry-picked or statistically fragile validation evidence. Any technical blocker is returned to raster 1.
Apply drawdown and near-ruin risk gates with veto authority. Any technical blocker is returned to raster 1.
Promote only a superior non-vetoed challenger, checkpoint state, then start the next generation at raster 1. Any technical blocker is returned to raster 1.

supervisor.name: TenDaySupervisor
supervisor.role: Research manager and sole promotion authority

research_agent.name: ResearchAgent
research_agent.role: Generate challenger parameter hypotheses through deterministic Hyperopt search using training data only

operations_agent.name: OpsWatchdog
operations_agent.role: Raster 1 central recovery owner: verify research health and safety, receive failures from every later raster, diagnose them, apply only whitelisted infrastructure repairs, and restart the same generation from raster 1 without user intervention

agents.name: QuantAgent
agents.role: Reward repeatable target hits and median return without using blind holdout data

agents.name: ValidationCritic
agents.role: Reject incomplete, failed, cherry-picked or statistically fragile validation results

agents.name: RiskAgent
agents.role: Penalize drawdown and near-ruin behavior and veto unacceptable capital-risk profiles

promotion.rule: No veto AND council score strictly exceeds current champion score
